look_here_first: Find an areole before anything else. On the flattened green cladodes, each areole is a specialized short shoot that can carry hairs, glochids, permanent spines, flowers, or new pads. Then compare pad shape, spine/glochid pattern, yellow-to-orange flower, and beet-red berry.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: succulent shrub made of flattened photosynthetic cladodes/pads

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: true defining cactus structure is the areole

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: areoles arranged across pads and bearing glochids plus zero to several permanent spines

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: glochids tiny, barbed, irritating, and clustered at areoles

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: pads commonly obovate and green to bluish-green/glaucous

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: large radial flowers usually yellow to yellow-orange

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: inferior ovary surrounded by stem/pericarpel tissue bearing areoles

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: many-seeded fleshy berry, beet-red with purple-red pulp

key_traits.label: Areole
key_traits.text: A specialized axillary short shoot. Learn this before 'spines': flowers, new stems, hairs, glochids and permanent spines arise from areoles.

key_traits.label: Stem
key_traits.text: The familiar pad is a flattened photosynthetic stem segment (cladode), not an ordinary leaf.

key_traits.label: Spines
key_traits.text: Permanent spines vary greatly even within the variety; do not require a fixed spine count. Glochids are smaller barbed deciduous spines clustered in the areole.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Large radial flower with numerous graded perianth segments and more than 200 free stamens in the detailed Williamson County treatment.

key_traits.label: Ovary
key_traits.text: Inferior; outer stem tissue around it bears tubercles/areoles.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Many-seeded fleshy berry, commonly broadly obovoid/top-shaped and beet-colored, with mucilaginous purple-red pulp.
